# Dictionaries

> A collection of personal glossaries at dictionaries.deltadelta.dev. Each dictionary collects terms and phrases from one field, such as software engineering, with a definition, an optional extended definition, and an etymology or source link.

The site is static. Each dictionary is stored as a single file in the source repository and is rendered to HTML at build time.

## Pages

- [Home](https://dictionaries.deltadelta.dev/): List of all dictionaries

## Optional

- [Source code](https://github.com/delta1513/dictionaries.deltadelta.dev): GitHub repository for the site
